name: Wicked Grain Custom Furniture
old_description: All of our items are made to last and we stand by our work! We support local farmers and mill workers right here in the Midwest and ALL of our items are 100% made in the US! We can do a wide range of styles and types of furniture pieces, but all of our items have a rustic or natural feel to them. We love using organic shaped slabs, pieces of wood with cool grains/knots/character marks, and wood that has a story.
about:
Wicked Grain Custom Furniture operates from Overland Park, Kansas, in the Kansas City metropolitan area. The company's database record indicates a founding year of 1916, though the website itself does not reference this date. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in the available sources.

The shop produces custom furniture from solid slab and reclaimed wood, emphasizing live-edge slabs with natural character marks, knots, and grain patterns. Every piece is built from scratch to order; the company maintains no pre-made inventory. Offerings include dining tables, benches, vanities, sliding barn doors, and smaller accessories such as cutting boards finished with food-safe oil. Production scale, facility size, and headcount are not disclosed.

The primary customer base is residential, with testimonials from homeowners ordering custom tables, vanities, and doors for private homes. The rustic, natural aesthetic also appeals to interior designers and hospitality projects seeking one-of-a-kind wood pieces. No specific commercial or industrial clients are identified.

The company highlights its commitment to domestic sourcing: all lumber comes from Midwest farmers and mill workers, and every item is 100% made in the United States. This local supply chain, combined with a made-from-scratch approach, is presented as the core differentiator.
built_on: Every piece custom built from scratch, no stock inventory
Live-edge slabs with natural character and grain
Free live-edge cutting board with orders over $1,000
type_evidence: All of our pieces are made from scratch and truly one of-a kind! Each item we make is "custom" and we have no items pre-made.
